Subject: Post-POC outcomes snapshot & quick endorsement ask

Alex —

Thanks again for running the POC with us last month. I wanted to put a short outcomes snapshot in one place and ask a quick favor if QuickCart is willing. High-level POC takeaways we surfaced on our end (attached dashboard):

- Latency: p50 improved from ~420ms to ~175ms (~58% reduction).
- Tail: p95 improved from ~1.2s to ~210ms (~82% reduction).
- Throughput: sustained tokens/sec increased ~2.8x on equivalent hardware.
- Cost: estimated inference cost per 1k tokens down ~37% after batching and KV cache.
- Quality: no measurable degradation on our evaluation set; F1 and relevance metrics within ±1.5% of baseline.

These numbers are on the test workload we ran during the two-week pilot and match the dashboard attached (quickcart-poc-dashboard.pdf). We’re putting together a short case highlight and would be hugely appreciative if you could do one of the following:

1) Reply with a one- to two-sentence endorsement we can attribute to QuickCart, e.g. a short statement about improved performance or reliability, or
2) Jump on a very quick 15-minute call so we can capture a 30-second quote on the call and confirm attribution details.

Suggested times (PST):
- Today 3:00–3:30pm
- Tomorrow 9:30–9:45am or 11:00–11:15am

If you prefer, I attached a tiny template (one-liner-endorsement-template.txt) you can edit and paste back. Also happy to route the short quote through Marissa or Ben for editorial polish.

Thanks again — your team’s feedback on stability/operational fit has already been super helpful for our product team.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
